question: How should one construct the six limbs from heart and faces?
premises: Six limbs arise from heart and similar places
Faces are built by ritual arrangement
Long vowels and six vowels join the formula
inference: The mantric body is constructed by arranging syllables into six limbs and faces.
uncertainties: @ may mark a damaged or split compound
tryarṇa may mean three syllables or three vowels
plain_english: This three-syllable formula, abandoned below and joined with six long vowels, one should construct as the six limbs beginning with the heart, and its faces.
